title: Election body
description: An election for one of the few elected offices (register row DK1743; spec-delta S1596; docs/institutions/elections.md): a steward (3 seats) or an auditor (1 seat). Signed by the operator, who convenes it and signs the result, never counts it. Candidacies are lodged before `opens_at`; ballots are COMMITTED (a hash) from `opens_at` to `closes_at` and REVEALED from `closes_at` to `reveals_close_at`; the result is a function of the signed ballots and the published `tie_seed`, which the log recomputes. One election at a time for an office until its result is in. Chain: none (prev is null).
